---
title: "Hi, I'm Rifqi 👋"
---

I'm **Rifqi Muhammad Harrys**, a geospatial mapping professional focused on marine and coastal areas. I work as an Expert Mapping Surveyor at Indonesia's [Geospatial Information Agency (BIG)](https://www.big.go.id/), where I help produce and update geospatial data for the coast and seafloor.

My work brings together bathymetric surveying, coastline mapping, GNSS, and satellite-derived bathymetry. I also develop geospatial tools and take part in research that makes mapping data more useful for coastal management and other applications.

**Explore:** [Projects](projects.qmd) · [Publications](publications.qmd) · [Work experience](work.qmd) · [About me](about.qmd)

## Selected work

- [Satellite-Derived Bathymetry GUI](https://github.com/rifqiharrys/sdb_gui), an open-source tool I developed to generate shallow-water bathymetry from satellite imagery and depth samples.
- [Indonesia Coastlines](https://github.com/piksel-ina/indonesia-coastlines), a coastline-generation project I contribute to for Piksel Indonesia.
- [Research and publications](publications.qmd), including research on satellite-derived bathymetry and tsunami hazard assessment.
